
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/bugshare/p/19216880" title="发布于 2025-11-13 10:34">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">嘿嘿，一个简单ElasticSearch小实现</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>周五临近下班，原本打算摸摸鱼，结果产品经理来个新需求。领导觉得 AI 服务器报价太贵，想先做个“低成本替代方案”来演示一下分析效果。于是，需求会议就开了。其中有一块功能是 <strong>“检索内容高亮显示并展示匹配度”</strong>，产品经理说这可以考虑用 <strong>Elasticsearch</strong> 实现。行吧，需求是他提的，代码自然就得咱来写了。那就开干吧 💪</p>
<h2 id="一启动-elasticsearch-服务docker-简单搞定">一、启动 Elasticsearch 服务（Docker 简单搞定）</h2>
<p>这里用的是 <strong>Elasticsearch 8.xx</strong>，主要是考虑我们项目还在用 <strong>JDK 8</strong>。</p>
<h3 id="1-docker">1. docker</h3>
<pre><code class="language-shell">docker run \
  -d \
  --privileged=true \
  --name elasticsearch \
  -p 9200:9200 \
  -p 9300:9300 \
  -e "ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms1024m -Xmx2048m" \
  -e "discovery.type=single-node" \
  -e "ELASTIC_PASSWORD=elastic" \
  -e "xpack.security.enabled=true" \
  -e TZ=Asia/Shanghai \
  -v /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro \
  -v /home/bugshare/elasticsearch/config/elasticsearch.yml:/usr/share/elasticsearch/config/elasticsearch.yml:ro \
  -v /home/bugshare/elasticsearch/data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data \
  -v /home/bugshare/elasticsearch/plugins:/usr/share/elasticsearch/plugins \
  elasticsearch:8.19.6
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-配置文件">2. 配置文件</h3>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># elasticsearch.yml
cluster.name: "docker-cluster"
network.host: 0.0.0.0

http.cors.enabled: true
http.cors.allow-origin: "*"

http.cors.allow-headers: Authorization
</code></pre>
<p>验证下是否启动成功：浏览器访问 <a href="http://127.0.0.1:9200" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://127.0.0.1:9200</a>，用户名密码：<code>elastic / elastic</code>，推荐装个浏览器插件 <strong>es-client</strong> 来操作更方便。</p>
<p><img alt="PixPin_2025-11-11_16-57-26.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202511/3715916-20251113102513115-1536729133.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="二java-集成-elasticsearch">二、Java 集成 Elasticsearch</h2>
<p>官方提供的 Java API 用起来有点繁琐，于是我去找了两个现成的封装框架：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Easy-ES</strong></li>
<li><strong>BBoss-Elasticsearch</strong></li>
</ul>
<p>下面是我整理的一份对比（AI 协助分析 👇）：</p>
<h3 id="详细对比表格">详细对比表格</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>维度</th>
<th>Easy-ES</th>
<th>BBoss-Elasticsearch</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>核心定位</td>
<td>极简 ORM，对标 MyBatis-Plus</td>
<td>企业级 ES 客户端 &amp; 数据同步框架</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>设计理念</td>
<td>用对象操作 ES，屏蔽复杂性</td>
<td>简化但不屏蔽，保留灵活控制</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>学习曲线</td>
<td>非常平缓（MyBatis-Plus 用户零上手成本）</td>
<td>中等，需要理解 DSL 构建</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>查询 DSL</td>
<td>自动生成</td>
<td>可手写，灵活度高</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>ORM 支持</td>
<td>强</td>
<td>基础支持</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>数据同步</td>
<td>无</td>
<td>内置高性能数据同步</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>代码侵入性</td>
<td>较高（依赖注解）</td>
<td>较低（注解可选）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>性能</td>
<td>简单查询快，复杂查询略逊</td>
<td>高性能，生产验证完善</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>文档 &amp; 社区</td>
<td>中文文档完善</td>
<td>文档详尽，维护积极</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>适用场景</td>
<td>快速原型、轻量搜索</td>
<td>企业级复杂查询、数据同步</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>我个人更偏爱能写 DSL 的方案，于是选择了 <strong>BBoss</strong>。</p>
<h2 id="三spring-boot-整合-bboss">三、Spring Boot 整合 BBoss</h2>
<h3 id="1-引入依赖">1. 引入依赖</h3>
<pre><code class="language-groovy">// build.gradle
implementation 'com.bbossgroups.plugins:bboss-elasticsearch-spring-boot-starter:7.5.3'
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-配置文件-1">2. 配置文件</h3>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">spring:
  elasticsearch:
    bboss:
      elasticUser: elastic
      elasticPassword: elastic
      elasticsearch:
        rest:
          hostNames: 127.0.0.1:9200
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-定义映射文件resourcesesmapperdemoxml">3. 定义映射文件（resources/esmapper/demo.xml）</h3>
<pre><code class="language-xml">// resources/esmapper/demo.xml
&lt;properties&gt;
  &lt;!-- 创建Indice --&gt;
  &lt;property name="createDemoIndice"&gt;
    &lt;![CDATA[
    	{
        "settings": {
          "number_of_shards": 6,
          "index.refresh_interval": "5s"
        },
        "mappings": {
          "properties": {
            "demoId":{
              "type": "text"
            },
            "contentBody": {
              "type": "text"
            }
          }
        }
    	}
    ]]&gt;
  &lt;/property&gt;
  
  &lt;!-- 高亮查询 --&gt;
  &lt;property name="testHighlightSearch" cacheDsl="false"&gt;
    &lt;![CDATA[
    	{
        "query": {
          "bool": {
            "must": [
              {
                "match" : {
                  "contentBody" : {
                    "query" : #[condition]
                  }
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "size":1000,
        "highlight": {
          "pre_tags": [
            "&lt;mark class='mark'&gt;"
          ],
          "post_tags": [
            "&lt;/mark&gt;"
          ],
          "fields": {
            "*": {}
          },
          "fragment_size": 2147483647
        }
    	}
    ]]&gt;
  &lt;/property&gt;
&lt;/properties&gt;
</code></pre>
<h2 id="四代码部分">四、代码部分</h2>
<h3 id="1-实体类">1. 实体类</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">// Demo.java
@Data
@ToString(callSuper = true)
@EqualsAndHashCode(callSuper = true)
public class Demo extends ESBaseData {
    // Set the document identity field
    @ESId(readSet = true, persistent = false)
    private String demoId;
    private String contentBody;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-控制器">2. 控制器</h3>
<pre><code class="language-java">// DemoController.java
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/es")
public class ElasticSearchController {

    @Autowired
    private BBossESStarter bbossESStarter;

    private static final String MAP_PATH = "esmapper/elasticsearch.xml";

    @GetMapping("/init")
    public ResponseWrapper&lt;Boolean, ?&gt; init() {
        this.dropAndCreateAndGetIndice();
        this.addDocuments();
        return new ResponseWrapper&lt;&gt;().success().setMessage("初始化成功！");
    }

    @GetMapping("/dropAndCreateAndGetIndice")
    public void dropAndCreateAndGetIndice() {
        ClientInterface clientUtil = this.bbossESStarter.getConfigRestClient(MAP_PATH);
        boolean exist = clientUtil.existIndice("demo");
        log.info("exist: {}", exist);
        if (exist) {
            String r = clientUtil.dropIndice("demo");
            log.debug("r: {}", r);
        }
        // Create index demo
        clientUtil.createIndiceMapping("demo", "createDemoIndice");
        String demoIndice = clientUtil.getIndice("demo");
        log.debug("demoIndice: {}", demoIndice);
    }
  
  	@GetMapping("/addDocuments")
    public void addDocuments() {
        ClientInterface clientUtil = this.bbossESStarter.getRestClient();
        List&lt;String&gt; contents = ListUtil.of(
                "在本系列文章中，我们将从一个新的角度来了解 Elasticsearch。",
            "本系列文章的动机是让您更好地了解 Elasticsearch、Lucene 以及搜索引擎的底层工作原理。",
            "我们先从基础索引结构开始，也就是倒排索引……",
            "倒排索引将 term 映射到包含相应项的文档……",
            "通过查找所有项及其出现次数……",
            "Elasticsearch 索引由一个或多个分片组成……",
            "“分片”是 Elasticsearch 的基本扩展单位……",
            "Elasticsearch 有一个“事务日志”，其中附加了要编制索引的文档……"
        );
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; contents.size(); i++) {
            Demo demo = new Demo();
            demo.setDemoId(Convert.toStr(i + 1));
            demo.setContentBody(contents.get(i));
            String response = clientUtil.addDocument("demo", demo, "refresh=true");
        		log.debug("response: {}", response);
        }
    }
  
    @GetMapping("/highlightSearch")
    public List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; highlightSearch(@RequestParam String content) {
        List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; list = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
        ClientInterface clientUtil = ElasticSearchHelper.getConfigRestClientUtil(MAP_PATH);
        Map&lt;String, Object&gt; params = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
        params.put("condition", content);
        ESDatas&lt;Demo&gt; esDatas = clientUtil.searchList(
          							"demo/_search",
                        "testHighlightSearch",
                        params,
                        Demo.class
        );
        log.debug("esDatas: {}", esDatas);
        // 获取总记录数
        long totalSize = esDatas.getTotalSize();
        log.debug("totalSize: {}", totalSize);
        // 获取结果对象列表，最多返回1000条记录
        List&lt;Demo&gt; demos = esDatas.getDatas();
        log.debug("demos: {}", demos);
        // maxScore
        RestResponse restResponse = (RestResponse) esDatas.getRestResponse();
        Double maxScore = restResponse.getSearchHits().getMaxScore();
        log.debug("maxScore: {}", maxScore);
        for (int i = 0; demos != null &amp;&amp; i &lt; demos.size(); i++) {
            Demo demo = demos.get(i);
            Double score = demo.getScore();
            // 记录中匹配上检索条件的所有字段的高亮内容
            Map&lt;String, List&lt;Object&gt;&gt; highLights = demo.getHighlight();
        		log.debug("highLights: {}", highLights);
            Iterator&lt;Map.Entry&lt;String, List&lt;Object&gt;&gt;&gt; entries = highLights.entrySet().iterator();
            while (entries.hasNext()) {
                Map.Entry&lt;String, List&lt;Object&gt;&gt; entry = entries.next();
                String fieldName = entry.getKey();
                List&lt;Object&gt; fieldHighLightSegments = entry.getValue();
                for (Object highLightSegment : fieldHighLightSegments) {
                    list.add(
                            MapUtil.builder(new HashMap&lt;String, Object&gt;())
                                    .put("highlight", highLightSegment)
                                    .put("score", NumberUtil.formatPercent(NumberUtil.div(score, maxScore), 2))
                                    .build()
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        return list;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>前端部分就略过了，主要看效果：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>匹配度 = 当前得分 / 最大得分</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img alt="PixPin_2025-11-11_17-02-24.png" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3715916/202511/3715916-20251113102513075-1113607633.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="五中文分词支持ik-analyzer">五、中文分词支持（IK Analyzer）</h2>
<p>发现中文没分词，默认是按单个字匹配。验证下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-http">POST /demo/_analyze
{
  "field": "contentbody",
  "text": "搜索引擎"
}
</code></pre>
<p>果然，默认没有中文分词。</p>
<h3 id="1-安装-analysis-ik-插件">1. 安装 <strong>analysis-ik</strong> 插件</h3>
<pre><code class="language-shell"># 进入docker容器
docker exec -it elasticsearch bash
# 注意跟es版本一致，不要高于es版本
elasticsearch-plugin install https://get.infini.cloud/elasticsearch/analysis-ik/8.19.6
# 重启
exit
docker restart elasticsearch
# 验证
docker exec -it elasticsearch bash
elasticsearch-plugin list
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-修改索引映射">2. 修改索引映射：</h3>
<pre><code class="language-xml">// resources/esmapper/demo.xml
&lt;properties&gt;
  &lt;property name="createDemoIndice"&gt;
    ...
    "contentBody": {
      "type": "text",
      "analyzer": "ik_max_word",
      "search_analyzer": "ik_max_word"
    }
		...
  &lt;/property&gt;
  
  &lt;property name="testHighlightSearch" cacheDsl="false"&gt;
    ...
    "match" : {
      "contentBody" : {
        "query" : #[condition],
        "analyzer": "ik_max_word"
      }
    }
    ...        
  &lt;/property&gt;
  
  &lt;!-- 分词查询 --&gt;
  &lt;property name="analyzeQuery" cacheDsl="false"&gt;
    &lt;![CDATA[
      {
        ##"analyzer": "standard",
        "analyzer": "ik_max_word",
        "text": #[condition]
      }
    ]]&gt;
  &lt;/property&gt;
&lt;/properties&gt;

```### 3. 控制器代码

```java
@GetMapping("/analyze")
public String analyze(@RequestParam String content) {
    ClientInterface clientUtil = ElasticSearchHelper.getConfigRestClientUtil(MAP_PATH);

    String result = clientUtil.executeHttp("demo/_analyze",
            "analyzeQuery",
            MapUtil.of("condition", content),
            ClientInterface.HTTP_POST
    );
    System.out.println("result: " + result);
    return result;
}
</code></pre>
<p>重启项目、重新初始化数据，再搜索一下，完美分词 ✅</p>
<h2 id="六效果展示">六、效果展示</h2>
<p>至此，一个小巧的 <strong>Elasticsearch 高亮搜索 + 匹配度演示 Demo</strong> 就完成了。<br>
下周领导要看效果？没问题，稳妥得很 😎</p>
